**Filed:** 2026-06-28
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new trade class — SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK + VIX>=18 AND VIX>5d_avg (escalating)
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The edge we are trying to capture is the sniper level break with a VIX trend filter. This setup aims to identify escalating VIX regimes, where the market is becoming more volatile, and enter trades based on level breaks. The hypothesis is that this combination of conditions will lead to profitable trades.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves identifying level breaks using the sniper level break algorithm and then applying a VIX trend filter to only enter trades when the VIX is escalating (i.e., VIX > 5d_avg). The entry logic is based on the level break, and the exit logic is based on a chart-stop-only approach with a premium stop as a catastrophe cap.
